Vd.bar_b_note: All three frames on both sides show a dark plank-ring wall with a row of identical blue banners and a uniform dark-green ground carpet, with no trunk, crown, warm lanterns or glowing core like board-a, so it sinks.

Ug.bar_b_note: Fenn, Oswin and Elder Maud now each have their own line, but Fenn's frame is a black void (Fenn not on screen), Fenn's and Oswin's portraits look alike (bearded, hooded), and the scene is a flat carpet under a grey-violet sky, so it sinks.

Qc.bar_b_note: The 'after' frame is the normal exploration HUD (TEAM 5/5, all bars green, the Calm tag) with a reward-style 'yields the glowmoss lanes / Great Candy' line, and there is no loss screen or loss state, so it sinks.

Hw.bar_b_note: The Stormcapra fleece, dark curled horns and blue accents match the owner style bar, and it stands about 1.5x the trainer's height; B's faint mid and faint end flatten it into a legless fleece pillow, and A's hit react barely differs from its stand.

Pv.bar_b_note: In all frames one even dark-green leaf carpet runs to a flat horizon, with sparse isolated trunks and a pale stone tower in frame 2 against flat lilac haze, so it has no forest walls, groves or layered distance.

Xs.bar_b_note: The Voltarach is readable in the brighter frames, but the player's creature is almost invisible against dark ground, the telegraphs are flat magenta rings and chevrons (A i06-i10, i15-i17, tell1/tell2 a-c), HUD panels fill both sides of each frame, and on B the camera sits in dark foliage or a trunk in i12-i16, so it sinks.

Tj.bar_b_note: The elder has a warm, appealing stylised face with clear eyes, a white hair and beard silhouette and a moss-green and brown palette that fits the key art's villagers; the materials are a little smooth and plasticky compared with the world.

Oh.bar_b_note: The stormglass node has pale blue crystal cues, but stormglass_crown reads as a pink boulder with tan wooden-looking shards and glowmoss is a flat, unlit pale-green blob on the uniform carpet, so it sinks.

Bi.bar_b_note: B's afters are distinct and site-specific (torn banners on the ground in rows 1, 3 and 5, an opened cage with a freed character in row 2, a smoking fallen tent in row 4), while A's afters keep the oxblood banners up in rows 1, 3 and 5 and change mostly through small debris; both sides share blurry low-resolution ground, flat terrain and a flat tiled wall texture in row 1.

Uv.bar_b_note: Break now has visible white-violet lightning bolts in the sky, but Calm and Building are near-identical frames (only slightly denser rain), so the storm phase does not read and it sinks.

He.bar_b_note: The gold-plated Voltarach with blue eyes matches the roster board and the 'staggered - punish now' cue appears with no magenta slab, but heavy HUD columns cover a third of each frame, the player's Sparkit is tiny, and the impact has little real-object effect, so it sinks.

top_changes.change: Rebuild the Stormheart finale as the board-a hero tree: a split giant trunk with a branching crown, a visible glowing lightning core, warm lanterns and walkways in place of the dark ring wall.

Break the uniform Stormwood ground carpet into dense groves, moss banks, black pools and clearings with tall trunk walls and layered fog to the distance, and keep the fight cameras out of trunks and foliage.

Replace the flat magenta telegraph rings and chevrons with real-object effects (white-violet lightning, sparks, scorched ground), shrink the side HUD columns during fights, and give each storm phase and the loss result its own distinct grade and screen.
